story.intro: Plov didn't belong to one place. It appeared, independently, wherever fire met grain and meat met spice. A universal recipe written not by one chef, but by humanity itself.

milestones.title: The First Pot
milestones.text: Rice meets fire in clay vessels. The recipe is born — different in every village, the same at heart.

milestones.title: The Spread
milestones.text: Trade routes carry the recipe across continents. Saffron, lamb, dried fruit, chicken, vegetables. Each version authentic.

milestones.title: UNESCO Heritage
milestones.text: Recognized as humanity's intangible cultural heritage — not because one place owns it, but because everyone does. A shared recipe carried across cultures.

milestones.title: On-Chain
milestones.text: A recipe that survived 1,000 years of distributed consensus moves to Solana. Same philosophy, new technology. Transparent, multisig-protected.

manifesto.intro: Most memecoins are jokes told once. We're building something that already passed the test — a cultural artifact that survived for centuries because it actually works.

items.title: Culture First
items.body: Most tokens borrow a cute mascot and call it a day. We're rooted in something older — a recipe that connects strangers across continents. Real story, real heritage, real meaning.
items.quote: If your meme needs explaining, it isn't one yet.

items.title: Fair Launch
items.body: No presale. No private round. No discounted VC seats. Before the market opens, a capped pro-rata Alpha Vault runs under published rules — the same rules for everyone who shows up. After that, the market sets the price, not us.
items.quote: Same fire, same kazan, same chance.

items.title: Transparent & Multisig-Protected
items.body: 45% of supply goes to airdrops over four waves. Just 8% for the team, with vesting scheduled over 24 months. Mint authority disabled forever. Treasury operations require Squads multisig with role-based thresholds and timelocks.
items.quote: The one who cooks it shouldn't own it. It belongs to those who share it.

wpTokenomics.fairLaunchText: No presale, no private round, no discounted allocations for insiders. Community airdrops follow separately published wave rules.

liquidity.title: Liquidity & Launch

archStages.desc: One-sided PLOV liquidity and capped Pro-Rata Alpha Vault; fill completes before public activation
Activation only after the final Go/No-Go; execution quality and routing monitored after launch

An additional liquidity backstop may be reviewed no earlier than T+24h and requires separate approval, Squads execution and verification. No rapid backstop is available during the first launch hours. Liquidity actions target execution quality, depth, and resilience — not price support.

liquidity.protectionText: The production pool address, position, custody controls, and transaction confirmations are published through Proof Hub only after execution and verification. Planned configurations are not presented as completed actions.
liquidity.cexNote: CEX listings follow a Tier-2 first approach: gradual expansion based on organic demand, liquidity depth and community metrics. Exchange fees may be paid. Paying for artificial trading volume and wash-trading are prohibited. Listings are announced only after confirmation.
liquidity.metricsNote: The values below are provisional planning references, not measured results or guarantees. Measurement methodology will be published together with the first monitoring report.
liquidity.launchPricePrinciple: The starting pool configuration, including the initial price, is fixed in the Liquidity Policy and published in Proof-hub at launch. It is not a guaranteed price, a price floor or a promise of value.

airdrops.title: Airdrops & Hold-to-Earn
airdrops.lead: 45% of supply is allocated to PlovDrop across four planned community waves. Each wave requires approved rules covering allocation, eligibility, unlocks and claim timing. Wave 1 readiness review may begin no earlier than T+24h after public activation; this is not an automatic claim opening. Proof-hub will publish dataset hashes and distribution evidence as the relevant stages are completed.
airdrops.antiSybilText: Anti-Sybil checks follow the published rules of each wave. Minimum SOL balance and activity thresholds apply only when specified in that Wave Policy. Duplicate records, exclusions and appeals are reviewed under those rules. Proof-hub will publish verification evidence without requiring public disclosure of every participant record. The only official claim hostname is claim.plovcoin.com; use HTTPS.
airdrops.loyaltyNote: Hold-to-Earn is a planned snapshot-based loyalty program funded from the separate 5% reserve (650,650,150 PLOV). It is not staking or a token deposit: tokens remain in your wallet. Eligibility, eligible balances, observation periods, reward calculations, caps and distribution procedures must be approved and published before the program opens. Holding tokens does not by itself guarantee a reward or an APY.
airdrops.loyaltyAllocationNote: PlovDrop tokens may count toward holding tenure, but do not automatically qualify for rewards from the separate Loyalty reserve.

featured.a: PlovCoin ($PLOV) is a cultural memecoin on Solana with fixed supply and transparent launch structure. It's built around plov — a universal symbol of hospitality and the shared table.

featured.q: What is the official token address?

Live trading is not open during the pre-TGE stage. At public activation, the primary PLOV/SOL market is planned on Meteora DAMM v2, with Jupiter routing after activation. No fixed Raydium or Orca launch schedule is announced.

No participation instructions are currently published. Use only verified official announcements; do not act on unsolicited offers. Anyone selling $PLOV before an official announcement is not PlovCoin.

featured.q: How do I verify this isn't a scam?
featured.a: Open https://plovcoin.com directly and compare the full token mint with Proof-hub and Solscan. For claim, the protocol must be HTTPS and the hostname must be exactly claim.plovcoin.com — not a prefix or a subdomain of another website. Claim is not open. We never ask for seed phrases or private keys and never DM claim links.
Only on claim.plovcoin.com. We will never DM you a claim link — anyone who does is a scammer.

featured.q: Will team tokens unlock at launch?
featured.a: The approved team allocation is 8%, with a 12-month cliff followed by 12 months of linear vesting; no team unlock is scheduled at launch. The deployed vesting account and execution evidence will be published on Proof-hub when available.

items.a: Plov is recognized across dozens of cultures as a symbol of hospitality, community, and the shared table. A cultural symbol tends to hold up better over time than a random meme character, and it doesn't rely on borrowed IP.

items.q: Is this a serious project or just a meme?
items.a: Both. PlovCoin is a memecoin, so it does not promise yield or guaranteed utility. But it is operated with real discipline: multisig treasury control, published addresses, Proof-hub transparency, and monthly reporting.
PlovArmy is the PlovCoin community — a growing group of holders, creators, and supporters united around the plov symbol. Official updates are published on Telegram and X.

PlovCoin is run by a pseudonymous core team with published operational roles and multisig-controlled execution. The public team structure is shown in the Team section, while sensitive operations are governed through Squads, timelocks, and Proof-hub disclosures.
Fixed supply of 13,013,003,000 $PLOV. No new tokens can ever be minted — the mint authority is permanently disabled.
Yes. Mint = OFF. The mint authority is permanently disabled. Verify on Solscan.
Yes. The official $PLOV freeze authority is revoked: the team cannot freeze this token’s accounts. This does not describe every asset in a wallet.

Yes. 7% of supply (910,910,210 tokens) is reserved for milestone-based burns only — not a price-support mechanism. All burns are verified on-chain.

We are preparing for a Q4 2026 public launch. The exact date will be announced through official channels only after communications readiness and the final Go/No-Go. The launch will be postponed if any critical requirement remains unmet.

items.q: What fees apply when buying, selling or transferring $PLOV?
items.a: The $PLOV token itself has no transfer fee. Solana network fees still apply; swaps may also incur pool and trading-service fees. The launch pool fee may start higher and then decrease under the published rules. Check fees, slippage and the final amount before confirming. See the Whitepaper for launch parameters and Proof-hub for the verified configuration.

The metric is p90 slippage for $1,000 trades. The provisional planning reference for the first 30 days after TGE is under 1.0%; this is not a measured result or guarantee. Measurement methodology will be published with the first monitoring report. See the Whitepaper for monitored liquidity metrics.
Listings are announced only after confirmation. Exchange fees may be paid; paying for artificial trading volume and wash-trading are prohibited.
PlovDrop is the airdrop program — 45% of total supply distributed through 4 waves per the approved Wave Policy. The largest allocation in the protocol.

items.q: How do I qualify for an airdrop?
items.a: Eligibility depends on the wave. Early waves focus on creator activity and verified community participation, while later waves add stronger on-chain and loyalty filters. Each wave is announced separately with its own criteria, timing, and claim rules.

There is no public claim schedule yet. Wave 1 review can begin no earlier than T+24h after public activation; review is not the opening of claim. Each wave requires approved rules, readiness checks and an official announcement.

Anti-Sybil checks follow the published rules of each wave. Minimum SOL balance and activity thresholds apply only when specified in that Wave Policy. Duplicate records, exclusions and appeals are reviewed under those rules. Proof-hub will publish verification evidence without requiring public disclosure of every participant record.

items.q: Is Hold-to-Earn the same as staking?
items.a: No. The planned program uses on-chain snapshots without a staking lockup or token deposit. Tokens remain in your wallet. Participation and reward distribution will follow the published Loyalty Policy.

Tier conditions and reward calculations will be published in the approved Loyalty Policy before the program opens. Previously displayed percentages should not be treated as active reward terms or a promised return.

items.q: What do I need to do to earn bonuses?
items.a: Follow the official announcement and published Loyalty Policy when the program opens. The rules will specify eligibility, eligible balances, observation periods, caps and how to receive any reward. Holding PLOV alone does not guarantee eligibility or automatic payment.

items.q: Where do Hold-to-Earn bonuses come from?
items.a: The program has a separate 5% Loyalty reserve (650,650,150 PLOV). PlovDrop is funded from its own 45% allocation. Airdropped tokens may count toward holding tenure, but receiving or holding them does not automatically create entitlement to Loyalty rewards. Eligible reward balances are defined by the Loyalty Policy.

Hacken’s review of VPS infrastructure, custody architecture and frontend code is complete. All 12 findings are marked Fixed. A verified public-report link will be added to Proof-hub. Future wallet-connect, registration and claim functionality is outside this review’s scope.
All treasury operations go through Squads multisig with role-based thresholds (3/5 for Treasury with a 48h timelock; 2/3 with 12h for LP, Marketing, Updates, Burns) and timelocks.

items.q: What about MEV and sniper bots?
items.a: Planned measures are described in the Alpha and launch-fee rules. The actual configuration is published on Proof-hub after verification. These measures do not guarantee the absence of bots, MEV or advantages held by other participants.

items.q: How do I report a security issue?
items.a: Email security@plovcoin.com. Confirmed critical issues may be eligible for a reward.

items.q: What is the official PlovCoin Telegram?
items.a: Official Telegram: @PlovCoinAnnouncements (EN announcements), @PlovCoinRU (RU announcements), and @PlovCoinKitchen (community discussion). Direct links and the Telegram folder are listed in Official Sources.

items.q: Does PlovCoin have a Telegram community group?
items.a: Yes. @PlovCoinKitchen is the official community discussion group. Joining it does not establish airdrop eligibility or guarantee rewards. Admins never DM first or ask for a seed phrase or private key.

items.q: Is the liquidity locked? Can the team pull it?
items.a: Production liquidity deployment is still subject to launch gates. The governance rules and currently verified accounts are listed on Proof-hub. A liquidity-lock or withdrawal-permission claim requires evidence for the actual deployed position; a plan alone is not that evidence.

The planned primary market is PLOV/SOL on Meteora DAMM v2, with a capped Pro-Rata Alpha Vault before public activation and Jupiter routing after activation. Participation rules and execution evidence will be published when the applicable launch gates are met. This is not a promise of a fixed price.

items.q: Will the team support or guarantee the price?
items.a: No. PlovCoin makes no price guarantees and defends no price levels. The project maintains an operational liquidity reserve for orderly market operations under multisig control, but it is never used to promise, fix or protect any price.

items.q: Why does the team use pseudonyms?
items.a: Memecoin culture favors pseudonymity. Public accountability comes from multisig thresholds, published addresses, and on-chain transparency.
Not yet. At launch, governance is transitional: core operations run through the team, Squads multisig, timelocks, and public operating rules. A broader governance layer may be introduced later.
